title: xuri/excelize/v2
notes: excelize.OpenReader on the bytes, then GetRows(sheet) per sheet, default options. Not passing: numbers come back formatted to 15 significant digits, so 0.008999999999999994 reads as 0.00899999999999999.
details: By default GetRows applies the cell number format (General), which prints at most 15 significant digits, so a stored double that needs 16 or 17 is changed. The RawCellValue option returns the stored text; see the raw variant.
